libstdc++_13.2-mingw-w64_mingw13_x86_lib.notes: Built from an exerciser that instantiates a broad slice of the standard library; the exerciser only selects which functions are pulled in, the code is libstdc++'s. libgcc helpers and the unwinder are in the sample too and are not libstdc++'s strictly, but they are the same GCC runtime and belong with it. The glue filter is off, because the probe it measures against is itself linked -static-libstdc++ and would delete exactly the code this recipe exists to collect.
